author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
purpose: Measure the unresolved WS01 background semantics without selecting any option from model fit quality.

hz_dataset.selection_rule_for_33_surface: source starts with CC_ and source label does not contain BAO
pass_when: the selected pure-CC rows from the 33-row source equal the independent 28-row source exactly at row level
fixed-vector H(z) chi2 is identical on the two pure-CC selections
excluded rows are explicitly reported rather than silently consumed
hz_dataset.decision_semantics_if_pass: independent_cosmic_chronometers_28 is evidence-supported for the canonical scientific surface; the 33-row file remains a named freestanding/parity projection

omega_r.decision_semantics: sensitivity evidence only; no option is selected without an explicit physical authority for the radiation-density convention

distance_integration.decision_semantics_if_pass: log1p_simpson with 2048 steps is evidence-supported for this declared background-domain tolerance; stricter downstream probes may preregister tighter tolerances

growth_mode.reason: WS01 evidence execution must not promote a background growth proxy to perturbation-derived f_sigma8.

invariants: no option is selected from chi2 preference
same model vectors are used across sensitivity arms
Omega_r is restored after every controlled perturbation
negative or inconclusive results are preserved
promotion_boundary: This experiment may reduce WS01 decision uncertainty. RX-PHYSICS-CANONICAL-V2 remains TOKEN_VAZIO_CONTRACT until every required axis has terminal evidence-backed semantics.
